meta.methodology: THI uses regressed preseason priors, roster continuity and personnel quality, possession-based opponent-adjusted efficiency, Four Factors, pace, regularized program-specific home-court effects and chronological walk-forward updates. Market prices remain evaluation fields. Situational flags are displayed as research context until each feature clears out-of-sample validation.
meta.inspiration_note: Away-from-home performance, record quality, quadrant-style records, rating movement and recent form are THI calculations inspired by useful public dossier concepts; no external proprietary rating is copied or used as a model input.
meta.player_projection_policy: Qualified prior production receives per-game counting-stat projections; unverified statistical profiles receive role and impact context only.
meta.home_court_policy: Program effects use five seasons of conference games, recency weighting and shrinkage toward the national mean; neutral-site games receive zero.
meta.situational_policy: Rest, back-to-back, lookahead and result-response flags are research context only. Injury and travel adjustments remain unavailable until verified feeds and out-of-sample validation exist.
meta.market_policy: Market prices are comparison and accountability fields, never predictive features.

home_court.methodology: Alternating regularized least squares estimates team-season strength and program-specific campus value together from conference games, reducing buy-game schedule bias. Five seasons receive exponential recency weighting; team effects shrink toward the national mean.

factors.evidence: Chronological team state built from possessions completed before tipoff.
Regressed preseason priors transition into opponent-adjusted current-season observations.
Five-season regularized estimates shrink toward a 2.77-point national mean; neutral sites receive zero.
Verified returners, recruiting and matched transfer production shape the opening prior.
Lines define signals, ATS grades and CLV; market prices do not fit the team-strength model.
Back-to-back, short-rest, lookahead, letdown and bounce-back states require incremental walk-forward validation.
Independent totals promotion checks have not cleared.
Requires a verified timestamped availability feed and auditable player-value translation.
Requires verified team origin, venue coordinates and chronological travel data.
Home/road eFG%, free-throw rate and opponent-turnover splits explain the court profile and are not double-counted.
